description: Tests markdown chunker records heading hierarchy on chunk metadata

skip.reason: python/node/ruby/elixir/php/zig run their e2e suite from e2e/<lang>/ without a chdir to test_documents/, so the relative uri cannot resolve; ruby, php and zig additionally have no generator support for the chunks_have_heading_context / first_chunk_starts_with_heading synthetic fields, and dart, kotlin_android and swift have no synthetic chunk assertions at all. homebrew is a CLI test_app with no result object to assert on.
